compiled_state.title: [T4][UPDATE] Flip hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled default to true in dso-config.conf
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Change the default value of hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled from false to true in dso-config.conf.

Change: hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled=false → hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled=true

This must only be done after skip markers are working (T2) to avoid false positives blocking legitimate commits.

Testing mode: UPDATE (config change; verifier baseline tests from T3 validate the behavior)
Dependencies: T2 (5409-cbd2-3af4-4e32)
